response.sql:
WITH matched AS (
  SELECT
    o.lunarstage,
    t.observstation,
    t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o
    ON o.observstation = t.observstation
), station_averages AS (
  SELECT
    lunarstage,
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY lunarstage, observstation
), phase_averages AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM station_averages
  GROUP BY lunarstage
), phase_counts AS (
  SELECT lunarstage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY lunarstage
)
SELECT
  c.lunarstage,
  a.avg_bandusagepct,
  c.telescope_count,
  c.telescope_count::DECIMAL / SUM(c.telescope_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total
FROM phase_counts AS c
JOIN phase_averages AS a
  ON a.lunarstage IS NOT DISTINCT FROM c.lunarstage;

assumptions.assumption: A missing lunar phase is grouped as NULL; station averages are computed within each phase and observatory station, ignoring NULL bandwidth values, then averaged across stations with a non-NULL average.
